title: World Commerce Corporation founded 1945

tellings.quote: There is an organization which is created initially in 1945 and it's called the World Commerce Corporation. On the board, Donovan, Stephenson, Ambrose, Dulles [music] doing the legal counsel.
there is an organization which was created initially in 1945 and then rebranded in '47. It's called the World Commerce Corporation.
tellings.difference: Adds the 1947 rebranding, places it in Panama, and credits Hambro, Levenda and Peter Dale Scott; Ambrose is not mentioned.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the World Commerce Corporation, founded in 1945 with Donovan, Stephenson and Dulles involved.

plain: In 1945, a company called the World Commerce Corporation was set up with a board drawn from the Allied wartime spy world: William Donovan, William Stephenson and Allen Dulles, with Dulles as legal counsel. The researcher Jason Simosa tells this to Michels twice. In one telling he names a board member called Ambrose; in the other he says the firm was rebranded in 1947 and based in Panama, names Charles Hambro instead, and credits the writers Peter Levenda and Peter Dale Scott. Simosa ties the company to the start of a secret network that he links to the UFO cover-up.
